units: <cite ref="Sukkah 33b:6">Succ. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>דאַשְׁחוּר אימת</he> when did they (the berries on the myrtle branch) become black?

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117b">B. Mets. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>דקא״ל קא מְשַׁחְרַת לי לכותלאי</he> Ms. M. (differ. in ed., v. <cite ref="U00716"><he>שַׁחְרוּרִיתָא</he></cite>) he may say to him, thou wilt make my wall black (by living in my house).—Part. pass. <he>מְשַׁחַר</he>; f. <he>מְשַׁחְרָא</he>; pl. <he>מְשַׁחְרֵי</he>; <he>מְשַׁחְרָן</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 28b:6">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מכי מש׳ כותלי</he> when the walls begin to grow dark (are no longer shone upon by the sun), v. <cite ref="K00429"><he>כּוֹתְלָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:9">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>חזנהו … דמש׳</he> he saw that the walls of his room were sooty.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד מאת׳</he> 8) <he>רישיה גריע ומְשַׁחְרִין אפוי</he> (not <he>ושיחרור</he>) his head shaved, and his face blackened; a. e.
